_comment: 学院页面断言: 页面就绪 + 扩展内容脚本注入形态（守卫节点由内容脚本维护时在此扩展）。用法: node <skill>/scripts/cdp.mjs verify --base http://127.0.0.1:9223 --checks tests/checks-mooc.json
expression: () => ({ url: location.href, readyState: document.readyState, hash: location.hash, hasVideo: !!document.querySelector('video'), bodyLen: document.body ? document.body.innerText.length : 0 })
